commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main plot-inbox
git reset --hard origin/main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd projects/kobra2-neo
uv sync --frozen >/dev/null
BASE=/tmp/kobra-stephansdom-ready-20260929-50
rm -rf "$BASE"
mkdir -p "$BASE"
git show 09cecee34ea3107a25a4deca1aba087c743e3d67:projects/kobra2-neo/inbox/current.svg > "$BASE/source.svg"
SOURCE_SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$BASE/source.svg" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$SOURCE_SHA" = "b8f500646869f0ce2e6e32b0448b55e13e76198c69ea0a275d8b41d9df48321e"
uv run kobra-plot prepare "$BASE/source.svg" -o "$BASE/job"
GCODE_SHA=$(python3 - "$BASE/job/report.json" <<'PY'
import json, sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert r['source']['sha256'] == 'b8f500646869f0ce2e6e32b0448b55e13e76198c69ea0a275d8b41d9df48321e'
assert r['safety']['valid'] is True
p=r['profile']
assert p['pen_up_z'] == 4.97
assert p['pen_down_z'] == 2.97
assert p['motion']['travel_feed'] == 6000.0
assert p['motion']['draw_feed'] == 2400.0
assert p['motion']['z_feed'] == 360.0
b=r['geometry']['output_bounds']
assert 8.0 <= b['min_x'] <= b['max_x'] <= 218.0
assert 41.0 <= b['min_y'] <= b['max_y'] <= 225.0
print(r['artifacts']['gcode_sha256'])
PY
)
uv run kobra-live "$BASE/job/output.gcode" --report "$BASE/job/report.json" --profile config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml --expect-sha256 "$GCODE_SHA" --validate-only
echo PREFLIGHT_OK
echo RESULT:READY_TO_PRINT job=$BASE/job source_sha256=$SOURCE_SHA gcode_sha256=$GCODE_SHA
